page_title: RBL 3-3 BAY | RB Leipzig v Bayern Munich 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' 3 - 3 It's 3:3! Xavi Simons feeds Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top of the net.
90+4' The attendance is 47800.
90+2' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) releases Yussuf Poulsen with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee is firm and issues Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) a deserved yellow card.
88' A substitution has been made. Serge Gnabry goes off and Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) comes on.
88' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to David Raum. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
87' David Raum (RB Leipzig) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
86' Zsolt Low has decided to make a change. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) replaces Lois Openda.
86' It will be a substitution. Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) is ready to enter the pitch as Kosta Nedeljkovic walks off.
83' 2 - 3 Goal - 2:3! Joshua Kimmich tees up Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Maarten Vandevoordt.

80' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Maarten Vandevoordt is alert and denies him with a nice save.
80' Good defending. Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) tries to find Yussuf Poulsen inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
79' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
78' Here comes a substitution. Kevin Kampl is given a rest as he is replaced by Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig).
78' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) will miss the next game.
77' Michael Olise floats over the corner and Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
77' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) prepares to take a corner kick.
75' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) rounds the keeper but the angle is just too hard to find the net.

75' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the middle of the goal but is denied by Jonas Urbig, who pulls off a comfortable save!
74' RB Leipzig are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
74' This is a yellow card! Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
72' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.

71' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates. Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
69' Zsolt Low has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) replacing Amadou Haidara.
69' Substitution. Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) on for Benjamin Sesko.

69' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
68' Total attempts – 6:16. Shots on target – 4:4.

66' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Maarten Vandevoordt makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.

63' 2 - 2 Goal! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) has a shot from the edge of the box which goes past the goalkeeper and into the back of the net. Serge Gnabry provided the assistance with a headed pass. 2:2.

62' 2 - 1 Goal! Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) jumps highest inside the box to meet the resulting corner from Michael Olise. His well-placed header ends up in the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. 2:1.
62' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is about to take a corner kick.

62' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
61' The game has come to an end for Sacha Boey. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich).
61' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Thomas Muller is replaced by Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich).
60' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
59' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
58' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
56' A pass into the penalty area from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by the defence.
55' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
54' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
54' David Raum (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.

51' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the left post, but Maarten Vandevoordt pulls off a fine save to deny him.
50' David Raum (RB Leipzig) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card. David Raum (RB Leipzig) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
50' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
49' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

49' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Leroy Sane, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception. Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
47' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Thomas Muller. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes a direct free kick. A player from RB Leipzig commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

44' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. RB Leipzig will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
44' Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig) was too forceful with his tackle and Felix Zwayer interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

40' Michael Olise whips in the corner and finds Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) in space with just the keeper to beat, but somehow he plants his header just over the bar from close in. He should have scored!
40' The referee awards a corner and Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes over to take it.

39' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! David Raum flights the free kick into the box, where Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) peels off his marker and heads straight into the left side of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 2:0.
38' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Felix Zwayer signals. A free kick has been awarded to RB Leipzig.
36' Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
35' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.

32' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
30' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range.
28' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips in a cross from the corner, but Maarten Vandevoordt is well positioned and punches the ball away.

28' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Bayern Munich will take a corner kick.

27' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
25' The ball is cleared after Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
24' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Michael Olise, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
23' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:2. 3:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
20' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
20' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends the corner into the box, but Maarten Vandevoordt intercepts it and averts the threat.
19' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) produces a killer pass onto Sacha Boey, who loses the ball to one of the defenders. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
19' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Maarten Vandevoordt comes off the line to clear the ball away.
16' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement.
14' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) works the corner short.
14' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Bayern Munich as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
14' Referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bayern Munich. Let’s see what happens!
13' Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Xavi Simons finds Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) on the edge of the area, he times his run to perfection and beautifully chips the ball over the goalkeeper. 1:0.

10' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Maarten Vandevoordt was alert and the score remains the same.
9' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
8' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) offside.
5' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.
5' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

5' David Raum (RB Leipzig) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
4' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) is penalised for holding. Felix Zwayer signals a set piece. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
2' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

2' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the left-hand post. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Jonas Urbig with a fabulous save.
2' David Raum (RB Leipzig) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
2' Benjamin Sesko received a sweet pass from David Raum (RB Leipzig), but the advance is stopped. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to RB Leipzig.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
RB Leipzig will kick-off.
Felix Zwayer was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
